# Completion definition

This bounded task is complete because all of the following are true:

- [x] bounded non-history context recall is complete;
- [x] current design-id is unchanged through the replay;
- [x] V9R positive and compile-success negative RTL evidence is current;
- [x] V9O focused, configuration, mutation, module and architecture evidence is
  current;
- [x] evidence-index build and verify both pass before ledger publication;
- [x] CONTROL-EVENT-G1 currentness checks pass without checker exceptions;
- [x] the result preserves the full-core GAP/PPA-unqualified boundary unless the
  canonical audit itself proves otherwise;
- [x] implementer evidence and an independent read-only review are both recorded;
- [x] task-run evidence, DB-first memory, task-specific e2e and strict guard are
  published.
